content.title: Headteachers consider leaving jobs earlier than planned after new Ofsted inspection
content.caption: Headteachers in England are considering leaving their jobs sooner than planned due to the new Ofsted inspections.

slides.heading: Headteachers consider leaving jobs earlier
slides.text: Headteachers in England are considering leaving their jobs sooner than planned due to the new Ofsted inspections.
slides.image_search_query: headteachers leaving jobs earlier United Kingdom

slides.heading: Impact on School Leaders
slides.text: The new inspections are described as much more intense and have caused significant stress and anxiety for many school leaders.
slides.image_search_query: intense inspections, stress, anxiety United Kingdom

slides.heading: Survey Findings
slides.text: A survey by the National Association of Head Teachers found that 64% of respondents were thinking of leaving their job sooner than planned, and 86% struggled with their mental health and wellbeing during inspections.
